extra.message: JWT tokens lack server-side revocation or logout mechanism

metadata.citation: auth_token = jwt.encode({'user': username, 'exp': get_exp_date(), ...}, app.config['SECRET_KEY_HMAC'], algorithm='HS256')
metadata.proof: User-supplied login credentials (line 180-182) -> JWT issued (line 184) placed in response Authorization header (line 187). The token is self-contained with no blacklist, no revocation endpoint, and no server-side session store. A stolen or leaked token remains valid for the full 4-hour window (get_exp_date returns +240 min) with no way to invalidate it upon credential rotation or account compromise.
